verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents a centralized cap table that replaces spreadsheets and covers each element of the story. Share classes are evidenced by preferred share issuance, authorized shares and class preferences. Certificates are evidenced by certificated and uncertificated shares, reissuance and e-signing. SAFEs can be added directly to the cap table, and ESOP/vesting management is listed. Stakeholder access, permissions, reports, a timeline, a data room and ASC 718 reporting support investor and auditor reliance, and a community user confirms real-time transaction updates. Missing for 10: explicit option-grant workflow documentation beyond 'ESOP management' and vesting, independent evidence that auditors actually rely on Eqvista as the system of record, and deeper hands-on corroboration beyond support-article titles.
